title: NMR spectroscopic and computational analysis of E/Z isomerism in imines derived from isatin
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12238-12245
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09983H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Andrés Gonzalez-Oñate, Diego Chaparro, Rodolfo Quevedo, Jorge Alí-Torres, Areli Flores-Gaspar
Isatin reacts with primary amines to yield mixtures of E and Z imine stereoisomers. This study provides a detailed structural analysis using 1H and 13C NMR spectroscopy, complemented by computational methods.
